title: America's Sweethearts
desc: When Kiki helps facilitate a final public appearance between her famous boss and her estranged husband, she experiences an unexpected spark of attraction and falls for him.

title: Teddy
desc: Srividya, a young woman, is put in a coma by corrupt doctors. However, her spirit enters a teddy bear and seeks out a lonely man named Shiva to uncover medical crimes.

title: Dragon
desc: After a harrowing break-up, a man becomes increasingly ambitious and begins committing fraud to gain more power.

title: Imaikkaa Nodigal
desc: Anjali Vikramadithyan, a CBI officer, sets out to track down a serial killer who the police claim was killed years ago. However, the investigation becomes personal when the killer targets her family.

title: Revolver Rita
desc: A woman begins to chase down the culprits after her handbag is stolen. However, things take a turn when the thieves find weapons in their loot, causing them to question the identity of their victim.

title: Kalki
desc: Kalki, an intelligent police officer, is assigned to investigate the mysterious murder of Sekhar, the brother of Narsappa, who rules the Kollapuram village.

title: Whistle Podu
desc: A man tries to fulfil his father's dream of opening a sports academy. However, complications arise when he becomes embroiled in a revenge scheme involving the mafia.

title: Renigunta
desc: Five juveniles stop at Renigunta after escaping from Madurai's correctional facility. Subsequently, they encounter a mysterious figure who introduces them to the dark underbelly of organised crime.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Vai Raja Vai
desc: Karthik, an engineer, possesses precognition abilities and uses them to his advantage. But when he decides to use his abilities to earn money by gambling, he lands in trouble.

title: Kolaigaran
desc: DCP Karthikeyan seeks the help of IPS Prabhakaran to solve a murder case. However, when Prabhakaran takes the blame, Karthikeyan is forced to find the truth.

title: Asura Vamsam
desc: A man, who has many police officers in his family, fails to become one after he locks horns with the police commissioner's wayward son.

title: Sembi
desc: Sembi and her grandmother, Veerathayi, travel in a bus, along with 24 passengers, who strive to help the duo seek justice for the wrongs done to them.

title: Uravukku Mariyathai
desc: Santosh decides to keep his grandmother Sita Mahalakshmi happy at any cost because she helped him in a game of hide and seek during his childhood.

title: Thudikkum Karangal
desc: Balu works as a clerk in Ramesh's estate and is very loyal to him. However, when Ramesh accidentally kills Balu, the victim's brother Gopi becomes furious and decides to avenge his death.

title: Mudinja Vazhu
desc: Seven young contestants take part in a reality TV show. They spend a week inside a haunted house and soon witness paranormal activities around them.
